patch_selection: coordinate lexicographic canonical order then deterministic evenly spaced indices; no outcomes
slide_aggregation: equal-weight patient aggregation; no cross-encoder row pairing
epoch_selector: minimum EMA(alpha=0.3) inner-validation full-risk-set Cox loss over epochs 10..40
training_loss: full training-partition Efron Cox (not minibatch Cox)
final_refit: fresh initialization, same optimizer and constant LR, inner-selected epoch; no test early stopping
clinical_skip: train-local Clinical Ridge initialization then joint optimization; no stacking or fixed in-sample offset
rna_top512: train-only variance on existing log2, duplicate-symbol-collapsed gene matrix; 90% measured eligibility; excludes 20 symbol-free source rows
group_tokens: 8 locked molecular groups, train-only top variance up to 64 measured genes per group; zero padding; group-size/overlap-preserving matched global gene permutation
cna: exploratory only; separate gene-set positive and negative log2 dosage means, train-local scaling
teacher: Clinical+S32 Ridge, 3-fold crossfit nested inner selection entirely within teacher train; heldout labels absent from preprocessing and lambda selection
SEL: INSPIRED: auxiliary C/R/P Cox heads; detached softmax of train-only auxiliary losses weights greater current loss more; coefficient 0.1
PAL: INSPIRED: coefficient 0.1, comparable-pair soft teacher ranking, student pathology-specific head; event/censor ties included, tied events excluded
wrong_pair: derangement independently inside inner-train/inner-val/outer-train/outer-test, blocked by cancer and inferred RNA missing-pattern platform; no labels
D0_reuse: identical B0 prediction/checkpoint, hash verified rather than redundant training
E1_scope: INSPIRED: paper Eq8 own-modality log numerator, weights actually multiplied; source swapped-numerator/dead-output behavior audited separately; confidence heads not claimed calibrated TCP
CP_selected: per outer fold inner-val Harrell argmax among A3,A4,A5; tie order A3,A4,A5; same selection across seeds for deterministic Ridge, neural varies by init
primary_aggregation: sum fold-local concordant numerator / sum fold-local comparable denominator, separately for Harrell and Uno60
pooled_OOF: sensitivity only; risk calibration varies across fitted folds

bootstrap.scheme: paired patient multinomial counts, shared over all arms and init seeds; within-fold pairs; mean of 3 seed deltas
bootstrap.multiplicity: Bonferroni simultaneous primary family intervals over 6 comparisons x 2 metrics; secondary descriptive

decision: joint positive simultaneous Harrell/Uno interval, positive all 3 init seeds, mechanism controls passed, no capacity or training invalidity; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE/INVALID/BLOCKED
public_boundary: code/config/aggregate evidence only; private IDs, OOF, labels, checkpoints and transforms never public

amendments.reason: RNA source removes 13 symbol-free rows and merges 7 duplicate rows, not 20 symbol-free rows; feature selection code unchanged
record hashes repaired after exact B0 risk identity; original records archived; no predictions/training changed
